title: Otso 1 km forecast at the air-quality monitors, live verification
truth: OpenAQ public archive (openaq-data-archive), UTC daily means of PM2.5 (>= 18 valid hours); it includes low-cost sensors; it reaches the archive about 4 days after the measurement
forecast: the published Otso 1 km forecast: ensemble mean of the daily mean at the monitor's 1 km pixel; lead L = the UTC day L - 1 after the issue day (lead 1 = the issue day itself)
monitors: 12136 OpenAQ monitors of the 2026 station set inside the 1 km domain; never an input of Otso
statistics: n monitors, RMSE / MAE / bias of the ensemble mean (ug m-3), in1090 = share of observations inside the p10..p90 range of the members (80 % if the spread is right), obs_mean = mean observation
